scope_statement: Independent, plural and criticism-tested BPM study covering B1–B10 and within-tradition composition. The field is treated as organisational and socio-technical as well as analytical and executable.
scope_boundaries: No requester repositories, sibling Evolved corpora, runtime designs or target-specific adoption claims were consulted.
Workflow and process mining are examined at documented BPM interfaces; complete algorithmic, formal and implementation histories of those fields are outside this lane.
Industrial/quality antecedents are traced through explicit founding-source discussion, not a claimed complete independent history of every antecedent school.
Business analysis, enterprise architecture and project management are distinguished at the problem/unit/decision boundary; their complete professional standards are not reconstructed.
No jurisdiction-specific legal compliance or sector-specific clinical/safety procedure is prescribed.
No effect-size meta-analysis, population prevalence estimate or complete database-indexed literature census is claimed. The denominator is the examined analytical candidate population.
Live products are not benchmarked as current commercial recommendations. Standards versions are distinct from implementation adoption.
Publication/deposit/issue/event dates are distinguished; the future 2026 BPM conference is not completed empirical evidence.

saturation_rationale.CRITERION: Decision saturation within declared scope, not a fixed source, property or search-round target.
saturation_rationale.OBSERVED_CLOSURE: All ten required families have explicit models, candidate dispositions, criticism and recency checks. The last substantive expansions separated citizen-development authority/support and declarative consistency from broader existing candidates; later checks refined author metadata, sample dependence, source locators and contrary-result limits without exposing another distinct uncovered BPM mechanism in this scope.
saturation_rationale.NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_EFFECT: Null modelling results, non-implementation and mixed workflow outcomes, maturity validity criticism, dual-use work accounts and current simulation counter-results materially narrowed or rejected claims rather than being dismissed as improper BPM.
saturation_rationale.REMAINING_UNCERTAINTY: Representative comparative outcomes of the exact composition, value conflicts and autonomous process revision remain open. Access-limited specific claims are bounded explicitly rather than invented.
saturation_rationale.NOT_A_CLAIM: This is not proof that no future publication, new context or deeper specialist study can add a candidate or revise a judgement.
